item.author: invalid@example.com (nvanaert)
item.dc:creator: nvanaert
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone,

We recently lost a VM's disk to thin pool metadata corruption during a routine live migration, and traced it to how a shared thin pool is handed from one node to another. The trigger is the third-party StarWind "StarLVM" storage plugin.
